positive_snippets: We had a great stay at this hotel. The staff were incredibly kind and attentive, always ready to accommodate our requests with a smile. Their willingness to help truly made a difference and made us feel very welcome. The cleanliness of the rooms and common areas was also good, which made our stay even more comfortable.

If you're looking for an affordable accommodation in GK area, this is the right place. The rooms are clean, the staff are friendly and the breakfast they serve is great. I really liked the modern coffeemaker in their restaurant. I could brew my own coffee whether it be a cappuccino or an Americano.

One thing that you'll need to keep in mind is, while booking Uber make sure to input either Bloom Hotel CR Park or Bloom Cafe. Otherwise, you might end up at another Bloom Hotel nearby!

I recently checked out after staying at your property from 29 dec25 to 3rd jan-26.I would like to extend my appreciation for the hospitality and services provided during my stay. The cleanliness of the rooms, efficiency of the staff, and overall comfort were commendable.

Overall, my experience was positive, and I would be glad to recommend your hotel to colleagues and friends. Thank you for your efforts in ensuring guest satisfaction.

Best regards,
Shubham Srivastava
negative_snippets:
I stayed at this hotel for a week, and honestly, the price does not match the room quality or the services provided. It was one of my worst hotel experiences.

Room: The room was not well maintained, and there was a lot of noise from outside, making it difficult to rest properly. Overall management felt poor.

Service: I paid for food during my stay but did not receive the food invoice at checkout. I was told it would be shared via email, but only the invoice for an extended one-day booking was sent. I tried calling multiple times to follow up, but the line was either busy or there was no response—no callbacks either.

Food: Very limited menu options, and the taste was below average.

Overall, not worth the price. I wouldn’t recommend this hotel based on my experience.
